_doc: Auction source catalog (slice #160). Each save rolls a hidden reliability per source from the band — different per save. Reliable sources cluster listings tightly around honest book (motivated-seller multiplier stdev ≈ stdevHonest); unreliable sources widen the distribution (longer bargain + overpriced tails). reliabilityBand is [min, max] for the per-save draw; bands cover the spectrum from clean national wholesale to fringe repo lanes.
